subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: For source channel replies, should OpenClaw keep automatic bare-text delivery as the default and add a narrower final-only escape hatch, or should channel/source turns move toward message-tool-only or final-only delivery by default?
rationale: The source-proven bug is real, but the fix changes a compatibility-sensitive delivery contract for existing channel users who rely on automatic assistant final replies.

options.title: Add final-only compatibility knob
options.body: Keep existing automatic delivery by default, add or reuse a narrowly scoped final-only/last-segment policy for affected channel and cron delivery paths, and document when operators should enable it.

options.title: Change channel defaults
options.body: Move high-risk shared channel/source turns toward message-tool-only or final-only delivery by default, accepting migration and model-capability fallout for stronger safety.

options.title: Land partial safeguards first
options.body: Review and land partial PRs such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102173 while leaving the broader default-policy decision open.

recommendation.title: Add final-only compatibility knob
recommendation.body: Keep existing automatic delivery by default, add or reuse a narrowly scoped final-only/last-segment policy for affected channel and cron delivery paths, and document when operators should enable it.

likelyOwner.reason: The current payload and delivery helper code is most recently carried by vincentkoc-authored refactor/release commits, making them the best available routing owner for the policy choice.
